## Summary
- Allow Reflex function vars as Recharts axis tick formatters.
- Reject dynamic string vars with guidance to use `FunctionStringVar`.
- Add regression tests and a changelog entry.

## Testing
- Recharts cartesian unit tests: 18 passed.
- `scripts/make_pyi.py --check` passed.
- Ruff focused checks and `git diff --check` passed.


Fixes #7257
title: fix(recharts): support function vars for axis tick formatters
